title: Braided Multisections and Symplectic Four-Manifolds with the Rational Cohomology of $S^2\times S^2$
summary: We construct symplectic four-manifolds by taking mixed fiber sums along explicit cyclic multisections in ruled surfaces. For a connected unbranched degree-$p$ multisection in $Σ_g\times S^2$, we determine the first homology and fundamental group of the complement and prove that its boundary is incompressible. It follows that no direct gluing of two such complements can be simply connected; moreover, the first homology of every direct sum retains finite quotients determined by the covering degrees.
